knowledge:
- key_parameters: type="metadata" = specifies loading metadata in loadCMapData ;; cellLine = filters CMap metadata by cell line in filterCMapMetadata ;; perturbationType = filters CMap metadata by perturbation type (e.g., "Compound" or "Consensus signature from shRNAs targeting the same gene") ;; zscores = path to the CMap z-scores GCTX file in prepareCMapPerturbations ;; method = comparison metric ("spearman", "pearson", "gsea", or "rankProduct") in plot and predictTargetingDrugs ;; labelBy = labels compounds by "target" or "moa" in plotTargetingDrugsVSsimilarPerturbations
- alternatives: Correlation methods can be "spearman" or "pearson", or "gsea" (Weighted Connectivity Score) ;; Drug sensitivity datasets can be "GDSC 7", "CTRP 2.1", or "NCI60"
- when_to_use: When you have differential gene expression results (specifically t-statistics) and want to identify cellular perturbations (gene knockdown, overexpression, or small molecules) that mimic or reverse the expression profile, or to predict targeting drugs and analyze their molecular descriptors.
- pitfalls: The CMap z-scores file (cmapZscores.gctx) is extremely large (~20GB) and requires confirmation or manual download ;; GSEA score is set to 0 if the enrichment scores for top and bottom genes have the same sign ;; Columns matching between drug sensitivity and perturbation datasets might fail if identifiers do not match (e.g., matching 'broad id' and 'pubchem_cid' based on 0 common values), requiring manual key column specification.

workflows.name: prepare_differential_expression_input
workflows.intent: Download ENCODE RNA-seq data, perform differential expression analysis, and prepare the t-statistics vector required for downstream cTRAP analyses.
input: cellLine (character string of cell line name)
gene (character string of target gene symbol)
workflows.stages: 1. Download ENCODE knockdown metadata ;; 2. Load ENCODE samples ;; 3. Prepare gene expression counts ;; 4. Convert gene identifiers to gene symbols ;; 5. Perform differential expression analysis ;; 6. Extract t-statistics and name them with gene symbols
workflows.code:
gene <- "EIF4G1"
cellLine <- "HepG2"

ENCODEmetadata <- downloadENCODEknockdownMetadata(cellLine, gene)
table(ENCODEmetadata$`Experiment target`)
length(unique(ENCODEmetadata$`Experiment target`))

ENCODEsamples <- loadENCODEsamples(ENCODEmetadata)[[1]]
counts <- prepareENCODEgeneExpression(ENCODEsamples)
filter <- rowSums(counts[ , -c(1, 2)] >= minReads) >= minSamples
counts <- counts[filter, ]
counts$gene_id <- convertGeneIdentifiers(counts$gene_id)
diffExpr <- performDifferentialExpression(counts)
diffExprStat <- diffExpr$t
names(diffExprStat) <- diffExpr$Gene_symbol

workflows.name: compare_cmap_perturbations
workflows.intent: Compare user's differential expression signature against CMap perturbations to identify similar or opposing cellular perturbations.
input: diffExprStat (named numeric vector of t-statistics from differential expression analysis, where names are gene symbols)
workflows.stages: 1. Load CMap metadata ;; 2. Filter CMap metadata for specific cell lines and perturbation types ;; 3. Load and prepare CMap perturbation data ;; 4. Compare differential expression signature against CMap perturbations ;; 5. Visualize perturbation similarity rankings and individual relationships
workflows.code:
cmapMetadata <- loadCMapData("cmapMetadata.txt", type="metadata")
getCMapConditions(cmapMetadata)
getCMapConditions(cmapMetadata, cellLine="HepG2")
getCMapConditions(
    cmapMetadata, cellLine="HepG2",
    perturbationType="Consensus signature from shRNAs targeting the same gene")
cmapMetadataKD <- filterCMapMetadata(
    cmapMetadata, cellLine="HepG2",
    perturbationType="Consensus signature from shRNAs targeting the same gene")
cmapPerturbationsKD <- prepareCMapPerturbations(
    metadata=cmapMetadataKD, zscores="cmapZscores.gctx",
    geneInfo="cmapGeneInfo.txt")
compareKD <- rankSimilarPerturbations(diffExprStat, cmapPerturbationsKD)
head(compareKD[order(spearman_rank)], n=10)
head(compareKD[order(pearson_rank)])
head(compareKD[order(GSEA_rank)])
head(compareKD[order(rankProduct_rank)])
plot(compareKD, "spearman", n=c(10, 3))
plot(compareKD, "pearson")
plot(compareKD, "gsea")
plot(compareKD, "rankProduct")
EIF4G1knockdown <- grep("EIF4G1", compareKD[[1]], value=TRUE)
print(compareKD, EIF4G1knockdown)
print(compareKD[order(rankProduct_rank)], 1:10)
table <- as.table(compareKD)
head(table)
names(attributes(compareKD))
attr(compareKD, "metadata")
attr(compareKD, "geneInfo")
plot(compareKD, EIF4G1knockdown, "spearman")
plot(compareKD, EIF4G1knockdown, "pearson")
plot(compareKD, EIF4G1knockdown, "gsea")

workflows.name: predict_targeting_drugs_and_descriptors
workflows.intent: Predict drugs targeting the user's differential expression profile and analyze the enrichment of molecular descriptors among candidate drugs.
input: diffExprStat (named numeric vector of t-statistics from differential expression analysis, where names are gene symbols)
workflows.stages: 1. Load expression and drug sensitivity association data ;; 2. Predict targeting drugs based on the differential expression profile ;; 3. Plot targeting drug predictions and compare against similar perturbations ;; 4. Load drug descriptors and prepare drug sets ;; 5. Analyze and plot drug set enrichment
workflows.code:
listExpressionDrugSensitivityAssociation()
ctrp      <- listExpressionDrugSensitivityAssociation()[[2]]
assoc     <- loadExpressionDrugSensitivityAssociation(ctrp)
predicted <- predictTargetingDrugs(diffExprStat, assoc)
plot(predicted, method="rankProduct")
plot(predicted, predicted[[1, 1]], method="spearman")
plot(predicted, predicted[[1, 1]], method="gsea")
plotTargetingDrugsVSsimilarPerturbations(
  predicted, compareCompounds, column="spearman_rank")
plotTargetingDrugsVSsimilarPerturbations(
  predicted, compareCompounds, column="spearman_rank", labelBy="target")
plotTargetingDrugsVSsimilarPerturbations(
  predicted, compareCompounds, column="spearman_rank", labelBy="moa")
descriptors <- loadDrugDescriptors("CMap", "2D")
drugSets    <- prepareDrugSets(descriptors)
dsea        <- analyseDrugSetEnrichment(drugSets, predicted)
plotDrugSetEnrichment(drugSets, predicted,
                      selectedSets=head(dsea$descriptor, 6))
